text: Dukkah is an Egyptian spice and nut blend. You can use hazelnuts, almonds, walnuts, peanuts, macadamia nuts, or a combo, whichever you like, add in things like toasted coconut, sesame seeds, sunflower seeds, pine nuts, dried thyme or other spices, chili flakes, etc. It can be used with eggs, salads, as a crunchy coating for fish or chicken, sprinkled on toasted bread drizzled with oil, tossed in with rice, sprinkled on vegetables like steamed or roasted carrots, etc. One of my favorite uses is to sprinkle it on avocado toast.
